description: USB-C charging stand for laptop, power only, no data ports, no network, no video output
fiche_technique: Ports: 2 x USB-A 3.2 Gen 1 (5 Gbps data), 1 x USB-C data, 1 x HDMI 2.0 (4K 60 Hz video output), 1 x RJ45 Gigabit Ethernet. Power delivery pass-through up to 100 W to the host laptop. Aluminium housing. Net weight 310 g. Input 20 V.
